options.product: Microsoft Entra External ID - external tenant
options.plan: Basic MAU; upstream workforce entitlement unverified
options.region: No external or upstream tenant region selected; storage destinations not verified
options.configuration: Standard external tenant; fixed Entra workforce v2 OIDC code/client_secret_post; JIT; no SCIM add-on or Graph bridge

conditions: Select browser-delegated custom OIDC in a standard-mode external tenant and a separate workforce-tenant web registration restricted to that organization; configure federation redirect URIs and attach the IdP to the application user flow.

The workforce guide uses organizations/v2.0 discovery but an explicit tenant-ID/v2.0 issuer. This draft selects that fixed tenant, not common, consumers, a multi-tenant issuer or domain_hint acceleration; it is not workforce B2B guest invitation, B2C or native authentication.

Use code/client_secret_post, the configured scopes/claims and required upstream consent. Resolve the guide's client_secret label against the supported wire methods in https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/external-id/customers/how-to-custom-oidc-federation-customers ; do not select client_secret_basic or the displayed-but-unsupported private_key_jwt.

Home-tenant MFA is not automatically trusted by External ID, which may prompt again. No authentication-control verdict, tested issuer validation, tenant entitlement or live integration is established.

The Basic MAU allowance at https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/details/microsoft-entra-external-id/ does not establish upstream licensing or paid add-on access; this is not a zero-cost guarantee.

evidence.summary: The workforce federation guide documents an organizational registration, fixed v2 issuer and external-tenant user flow. Proposed OPTIONAL is conditional on exact configuration, claims and consent, not tested federation or transferred MFA assurance.

conditions: First federated sign-up through the attached user flow creates an external-tenant customer account; the guide's separate Graph user-creation alternative is not selected.

Review issuer-bound sub and explicit claim/user-flow attribute mappings at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/external-id/customers/reference-oidc-claims-mapping-customers . Do not borrow Auth0's oid choice, WorkOS objectId/externalId or Graph pre-created-user identities as this OIDC JIT mapping.

The workforce guide requires email while the generic guide allows a user-flow-wide optional-email setting; resolve the selected claim behavior before live sign-up. When email is present the claims reference requires truthful email_verified, not a constant true or email-only identity merge.
User-flow creation does not verify repeat-login attribute updates, account linking, ongoing directory/group synchronization or immediate application permission, session and token revocation.

evidence.summary: The guide distinguishes first-sign-up account creation from administrator Graph provisioning. This proposed JIT path retains unresolved email/claim behavior and does not establish continuing lifecycle synchronization.

conditions: The required direction is workforce-tenant provisioning into this Basic external customer directory, not workforce outbound provisioning to another SaaS or OIDC sign-up.

The separate Entra SCIM server API needs P1 and an Azure-linked paid add-on; it is excluded here, and external-tenant applicability, workforce client interoperability and identity correlation remain unverified.

No paid add-on or Graph bridge is selected. UNKNOWN is not UNAVAILABLE; establish the inbound endpoint, entitlement, update/disable semantics and separate SaaS access/session enforcement before assigning availability.

evidence.summary: The billed Entra SCIM server guide does not establish an included workforce-to-Basic-external-tenant provisioning path. Shared vendor branding does not supply pair-specific lifecycle evidence.

conditions: External-tenant group administration, Graph membership edits and application roles do not establish group synchronization from the upstream workforce directory.
No Graph bridge is selected; native inbound group entitlement, stable identifiers, membership removals, nested-group behavior and deletions remain unverified for this pair.

OIDC group claims and JIT are not a SCIM Group lifecycle. Application-owned authorization and session/token revocation need independent evidence; UNKNOWN is not a claim that all group APIs are absent.

evidence.summary: The external-tenant table documents local group and role management, not workforce-to-external-tenant inbound Group lifecycle synchronization for this Basic scope.
